channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Supreme Court rejects challenge to Maryland gun restrictions
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court has rejected a challenge to Maryland's law restricting firearms in "sensitive places." The court's decision means the state's existing restrictions on carrying guns in locations like schools, public transit, and… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Sony defeats £2 billion UK claim over PlayStation Store pricing
item.description: Sony has defeated a £2 billion claim in the United Kingdom concerning alleged anti-competitive pricing on the PlayStation Store. The claim was brought by a group of consumers represented by consumer champion Alex Neill. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Dead Racehorse Found in Skip After Prestigious Race
item.description: A dead racehorse was discovered in a skip days after competing in a prestigious race. The waste management company has provided an explanation for the incident, which has been described as "distressing and completely unacceptable." Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Charles Bronson denied parole for ninth time
item.description: Charles Bronson, a high-profile inmate known as 'Britain's most violent prisoner', has been denied parole for the ninth time. He will remain in jail following the decision. The specific location of his incarceration has been referred to as… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Mexican Drug Kingpin Rafael Caro Quintero Dies in Prison
item.description: Rafael Caro Quintero, a notorious Mexican drug kingpin and founder of the Guadalajara Cartel, has died in prison. He was 69 years old. Caro Quintero was serving a sentence for the 1985 murder of U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA)… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Russian military plane crashes in Siberia, killing 19
item.description: A Russian military plane crashed in Siberia's Kemerovo region, resulting in the deaths of all 19 people on board. Russia's defense ministry preliminarily believes a technical malfunction caused the crash. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Israeli Settlers Kill Palestinian Woman; Deutsche Bank Arms Israel Claim
item.description: A 72-year-old Palestinian woman was shot dead by Israeli settlers in the West Bank village of al-Duyuk al-Tahta, according to Palestinian health ministry officials. The Israeli military stated that the settlers fired after being attacked… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court Stays Life Sentences for Two Bilkis Bano Case Convicts
item.description: The Supreme Court has stayed the life sentences of two convicts in the Bilkis Bano case. Bilkis Bano stated that the Supreme Court halted the convicts' sentences without hearing her, and she is "scared again." The court's decision involved… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Madras High Court strikes down Tamil Nadu mineral transport ban
item.description: The Madras High Court has struck down a Tamil Nadu government rule that banned the transportation of minerals to other states. The court's decision invalidates the restriction imposed by the state. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Calcutta High Court upholds death penalty in child rape and murder case
item.description: The Calcutta High Court has upheld a death sentence in a child rape and murder case from Hooghly. This marks the first time in 34 years that the court has upheld such a penalty in a child rape case. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: NGT Refuses Stay on Musi Riverfront Project Challenge
item.description: The National Green Tribunal (NGT) has refused to grant an interim stay on a plea that challenges the Musi riverfront project. The project's opponents had sought the stay, but the tribunal declined their request. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Telangana High Court orders facilities for women lawyers and rescued women
item.description: The Telangana High Court has directed that toilets for women advocates are essential for effective justice, following a plea that highlighted the lack of separate washrooms for women lawyers, litigants, and staff at Jogulamba Gadwal… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: LeT terrorist Lateef Bhat killed in Kulgam encounter
item.description: Security forces killed Lashkar-e-Taiba (LeT) terrorist Mohammad Lateef Bhat in an anti-terror operation in Kulgam district, Jammu and Kashmir, on Wednesday. Bhat, described as the last known active LeT terrorist in Kashmir, was reportedly… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Minor Allegedly Sexually Assaulted Under Pretext of Marriage
item.description: In separate incidents, two minors were allegedly sexually assaulted after being promised marriage. In Kaithal, a fugitive accused of raping a minor under the pretext of marriage was arrested after being underground for three years. In… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Sunny Deol's 'Suryaa' Faces Certification Issues, Postponed
item.description: Sunny Deol's film 'Suryaa' has been postponed due to a certification roadblock and backlash from doctors. The Delhi High Court has closed a plea against the film after its makers agreed to include a disclaimer stating it is a 'work of… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Karnataka HC Halts Police Probes in Voter Deletion Cases
item.description: The Karnataka High Court has stayed police investigations into three additional cases concerning the alleged fraudulent use of Form 7 to delete Muslim voters. This follows earlier orders where the court had already halted similar probes… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: NIA arrests deported suspect in Punjab railway blast case
item.description: The National Investigation Agency (NIA) has arrested a key accused in the Punjab railway line blast case, who was deported from the US. This arrest brings the total number of individuals held in connection with the case to eight. The… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Armed Robbery at Jewelry Showroom in Bettiah, Bihar
item.description: In Bettiah, Bihar, armed robbers looted a Senco Gold & Diamond showroom of an estimated 40 crore rupees on Wednesday afternoon. Six to eight assailants reportedly held employees hostage, stole gold and cash, and assaulted one employee who… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Security forces engage terrorist hiding in Kulgam mosque
item.description: Security forces in Kulgam, Kashmir, engaged in an encounter with a Lashkar terrorist who had taken shelter inside a mosque. Reports indicate that the forces exercised restraint during the operation. The terrorist, identified as Lateef… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Supreme Court Dismisses Plea to Ban Animal Sacrifice
item.description: The Supreme Court of India has dismissed a petition that sought to ban the sacrifice of animals during religious ceremonies. The court's decision upholds the practice, which is part of certain religious traditions. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Oracle Java Users Urged to Update Systems Amid Cyber Attack Risk
item.description: Users of Oracle Java have been alerted to a cyber attack risk due to identified flaws, prompting calls for immediate security updates. The US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) and South Korea's cybersecurity agency… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Bombay High Court Criticizes BMC Over Temporary Road Cleaning
item.description: The Bombay High Court has criticized the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) for conducting temporary road cleaning operations, describing it as a 'two-day show' specifically before visits by dignitaries, including royals. The court… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: TN Govt Asks SC to Stay HC Order on Thiruparankundram Pillar Lamp
item.description: The Tamil Nadu government has urged the Supreme Court to stay a Madras High Court order that permitted the lighting of the Karthigai Deepam at a stone pillar lamp near the Sikandar Badusha Dargah atop Thiruparankundram hill in Madurai. The… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Prime Accused Arrested in Madurai Tanishq Jewelry Heist
item.description: The prime accused in the Madurai Tanishq jewelry showroom heist has been arrested in Dharmapuri. The arrest follows the police's investigation into the robbery, which involved blinding CCTV cameras. A YouTuber and Naam Tamilar Katchi (NTK)… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Pakistani National Sentenced to 27 Years for Plot to Kill Trump
item.description: Asif Merchant, a 48-year-old Pakistani national, has been sentenced to 330 months (27.5 years) in prison by a U.S. District Court in Brooklyn. Merchant was convicted for attempting to commit an act of terrorism, specifically a plot to… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 3 · Right 4.

item.title: Supreme Court: Skipping Party Meeting is Not Defection
item.description: The Supreme Court heard arguments in the Shiv Sena leadership dispute, with the faction led by Eknath Shinde asserting that skipping a party meeting does not constitute defection. This argument was presented to the court as part of the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: US Soldier Accused of Spying for Russia Transferred to US Custody
item.description: An American soldier, assigned to NATO, has been transferred to US military custody in the United Kingdom. The soldier was arrested in the UK on suspicion of spying for Russia. The transfer occurred after the arrest. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: International Court to Rule on Myanmar Rohingya Expulsion
item.description: The International Court of Justice (ICJ) is set to deliver a ruling on Thursday regarding whether Myanmar's expulsion of the Rohingya constitutes genocide. Concerns have been raised about potential US sanctions against ICJ judges… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Gérard Depardieu withdraws appeal of sexual assault conviction
item.description: French actor Gérard Depardieu has withdrawn his appeal against a sexual assault conviction. Depardieu had been found guilty of sexual assault in December 2023. He stated, 'I have been found guilty.' Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Delhi court seeks report on complaint against Sonia Gandhi
item.description: A Delhi court has directed the police to file an action taken report concerning a complaint against Sonia Gandhi. The complaint relates to an alleged discrepancy in the electoral roll from 1980. The court's order follows a plea seeking an… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Paris Hilton lobbies US Congress for DEFIANCE Act against deepfakes
item.description: Paris Hilton visited Capitol Hill to advocate for the passage of the DEFIANCE Act, a bipartisan bill aimed at combating sexually explicit deepfake images. She stated that the abuse she has faced has not stopped and urged the US Congress to… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 2.

item.title: Two Teens Die in Police Pursuit Crash in Coweta County
item.description: Two teenagers were killed and one was seriously injured following a car crash that occurred during a police pursuit in Coweta County. A man has been accused of causing the two deaths while fleeing police and reportedly cried in court. He… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: Russell Brand faces scrutiny over prison statement and past allegations
item.description: Comedian Russell Brand is under investigation following an "appalling" prison statement he shared. An accuser stated the message was "an insult to victims." Separately, a woman who alleges she was raped by Brand at 16 said a change in… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Indian-origin man charged in Minnesota assault case
item.description: An Indian-origin man has been charged in connection with the assault of a Somali Uber driver in Minnesota, United States. The incident reportedly involved the phrase 'I don't like that name.' The victim is described as Somali-American. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Critical Java Security Flaw Discovered, Urgent Advisories Issued
item.description: A critical security flaw, dubbed Java4Shell, has been discovered in Java, the world's third-largest programming language. Security researchers uncovered the bug using AI, and it is reportedly different from a PHP flaw, PHP2Shell, found… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Azam Khan Granted Bail in ED Case, Allahabad HC Calls Arrest 'Motivated'
item.description: Azam Khan has been granted bail in a case registered by the Enforcement Directorate (ED). The Allahabad High Court, while granting bail, stated that the arrest was 'motivated'. The Supreme Court, however, refused to pause Azam Khan's… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: Deutsche Bank Faces Scrutiny Over Alleged Illicit Transactions and Arms Funding
item.description: Deutsche Bank is facing scrutiny following the public release of internal documents alleging the bank facilitated potentially illicit transactions and funded arms dealers. Reports indicate these documents suggest the bank may have bent… Coverage: Left 5 · Centre 7 · Right 0.

item.title: US Intel Concerned Over Reported Iranian Dirty Bomb Plot in DC
item.description: US intelligence agencies are reportedly concerned that Iran may be plotting to use a "dirty bomb" in Washington D.C. President Donald Trump stated the US is taking these reports seriously. Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson has denied… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: US National Security Communications Network Suffers Outage
item.description: A highly classified United States national security communications network experienced an outage, according to the National Security Agency (NSA). Sources also confirmed the network went down. The specific nature of the outage and its… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court Takes Action Over Remarks Against Judges and CJI
item.description: The Supreme Court has taken action in multiple instances involving remarks made against judges and the Chief Justice of India (CJI). The Supreme Court Bar Association (SCBA) moved the Supreme Court to initiate contempt proceedings against… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 7 · Right 3.
